scope: Optimized: 30 drags and 120 outline observations per idle/scroll/physical disk load. Raw: one drag/four outlines per load; functional only.
Full recomposition after release and idle outlines. Loaded outline oracle excludes changing console client pixels, retaining frame/background/outline checks.
Screen-edge clamping, reversal, Escape, real native event-queue overflow, hide, cooperative close refusal and shutdown while held.
Visible observations are completed-scanout upper bounds. Release oracle stops/drains the producer; physical I/O may extend that bound.
These runs used all original passive IRQ markers. The checked-in runner now streams publications and selects fewer markers to bound host trace memory.
Sampler code is unchanged; DT3 electrical/SIO envelope remains the separate capture record. Timing targets remain open; this does not qualify physical hardware.
